verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own event-driven rules. An APM rule can automatically create a PagerDuty incident when an issue is triggered, and error groups can be auto-ignored by condition (time period, occurrence count, or rule). Custom alerts can go to email, Slack or Teams. These are narrow, alert- and status-oriented rules rather than a general rule→action automation engine. Missing for 10: a documented general rule builder with configurable triggers and actions, detail on the rule conditions available, programmatic/AI-native rule definition, and independent corroboration.
